interval '73 hour' AND r.meas_dt < NOW() ), -- 2단계: 72시간 내 실제 term_cv로 집계 meas_summary AS ( SELECT point_sq, MAX(meas_dt) AS max_meas_dt, MIN(meas_dt) AS min_meas_dt, MAX(real_term_cv) AS max_term_cv, MIN(real_term_cv) AS min_term_cv, MAX(stat_cd) AS stat_cd FROM raw_with_real_term WHERE real_term_cv IS NOT NULL AND meas_dt >= NOW() - interval '72 hour' GROUP BY point_sq ), -- 3단계: meas_summary의 point만 고객 조회 customer_filtered AS ( SELECT p.point_sq, p.site_sq, c.admin_no, c.cust_sq, c.cust_name, c.zipcode, c.addr_new, c.business_name, c.pipe_diameter, c.receive_consent, c.read_responsi, c.cust_phone, c.remark, d.company_sq, COALESCE( (SELECT leak_rule FROM tb_m1_rule_waterleak WHERE business_name = c.business_name AND pipe_diameter <= c.pipe_diameter ORDER BY pipe_diameter DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT leak_rule FROM tb_m1_rule_waterleak WHERE business_name = '기타' AND pipe_diameter <= c.pipe_diameter ORDER BY pipe_diameter DESC LIMIT 1) ) AS leak_threshold FROM tb_m1_info_customer c JOIN tb_m1_info_point p ON c.cust_sq = p.cust_sq LEFT JOIN tb_m1_cmap_device d ON d.point_sq = p.point_sq WHERE p.use_cd = '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM meas_summary ms WHERE ms.point_sq = p.point_sq ) ), -- 4단계: 누수 필터링 (최소값 비교) leak_suspects AS ( SELECT cf.*, ms.max_meas_dt, ms.min_meas_dt, ms.max_term_cv, ms.min_term_cv, ms.stat_cd FROM customer_filtered cf JOIN meas_summary ms ON ms.point_sq = cf.point_sq WHERE ms.min_term_cv > cf.leak_threshold ), -- 5단계: max/min term_cv 발생 시각 조회 term_cv_dates AS ( SELECT rt.point_sq, MIN(CASE WHEN rt.real_term_cv = ls.max_term_cv THEN rt.meas_dt END)::timestamp AS max_term_cv_date, MIN(CASE WHEN rt.real_term_cv = ls.min_term_cv THEN rt.meas_dt END)::timestamp AS min_term_cv_date FROM leak_suspects ls JOIN raw_with_real_term rt ON rt.point_sq = ls.point_sq AND rt.meas_dt >= NOW() - interval '72 hour' GROUP BY rt.point_sq ), -- 6단계: 알림톡 이력 (leak_suspects의 admin_no만) alrim AS ( SELECT h.admin_no, MAX(h.ins_dt) AS last_ins_dt FROM tb_m1_alrimtok_history h WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM leak_suspects ls WHERE ls.admin_no = h.admin_no ) GROUP BY h.admin_no ) SELECT (ROW_NUMBER() OVER()) AS "num", t.* FROM ( SELECT ls.point_sq AS "pointSq", ls.site_sq AS "siteSq", ls.max_meas_dt::timestamp AS "max_date", ls.min_meas_dt::timestamp AS "min_date", ls.min_meas_dt::timestamp AS "leak_start_date", ls.max_term_cv AS "max_term_cv", td.max_term_cv_date AS "max_term_cv_date", ls.min_term_cv AS "min_term_cv", td.min_term_cv_date AS "min_term_cv_date", ls.leak_threshold AS "leak_threshold", ls.cust_sq AS "cust_sq", ls.cust_name AS "cust_nm", ls.admin_no AS "admin_id", ls.business_name AS "use_type", ls.pipe_diameter AS "pipe_dia", ls.zipcode AS "zipcode", ls.addr_new AS "addr_new", ls.receive_consent AS receive_consent, CASE WHEN ls.stat_cd IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "stat_yn", ls.read_responsi AS "read_responsi", ls.cust_phone AS "cust_phone", ls.remark AS "remark", al.last_ins_dt::timestamp AS "last_send_date", ls.company_sq AS "comSq" FROM leak_suspects ls LEFT JOIN term_cv_dates td ON td.point_sq = ls.point_sq LEFT JOIN alrim al ON al.admin_no = ls.admin_no ORDER BY ls.point_sq ) AS t
